openingMessage: The most important thing in the world is family and love. Never forget that.
openingWhy: Every rule we run — the attendant who stays put, the tested atmosphere, the staged rescue — traces back to some kitchen table that got a phone call instead of a truck in the driveway. The standard was never for the client. It's for whoever is waiting on you tonight.
leadershipThought: Nobody wins alone. Nobody builds a company alone. Nobody protects a location alone. We succeed by winning the small daily battles: the extra phone call, the extra equipment check, the willingness to help.
exxonMoments:
Stop Work Authority Exercised — Unsafe Man Basket Operations (Line of Fire)
Man basket work is one of the highest-risk lift operations on an oil and gas site — Stop Work Authority before elevation is always the right call when anything about the setup looks wrong.

Exclusion Zone Breach — Third-Party Personnel (Near Miss) (Line of Fire)
When SimOps create unplanned traffic near your exclusion zone, proactive interception by all crew members — not just the safety tech — is what prevents a line-of-fire exposure.
